gaps.what: Operations Yoav and Hiram (October 1948): the northern Negev and Galilee gains between the 1948 and 1949 shapes are not dated
Shape steps of 1953 (-498 km2), 2006 (+1,602 km2) and 2014 (-1,730 km2) have no explaining event
Staged Israeli withdrawals from the Sinai 1974-1982 (Sinai I and II, 1979-1982) are not dated; only 1982 is given
Israeli occupations of southern Lebanon in October 1948 and March 1978 (recorded in the lebanon dossier) are not entered; West Bank Areas A/B/C and the 1994 Gaza-Jericho transfers are not mapped
Israel's matching loss of Naharayim and Tzofar to Jordan (26 October 1994) is not entered
British mandate-period control events (15 May 1923 recognition, 20 February 1928 agreement) belong in the British dossier as vassal events; the 27 June 1967 East Jerusalem act is year-level only
The 1965 Saudi exchange figures on the page (+6,000 and -7,000 km2) do not reproduce the 7,700 km2 drop between the Cliopatria 1960 and 1967 shapes; Talal's end year is not on the page
No page describes a 1948 Palestinian government; the row is kept as the owner of Jordanian-occupied land and the founding is confidence 1
Saudi-Qatar land frontier and the Hawar/Zubarah dispute before 2001 are not dated; Doha is not called capital for 1916-1971 by the History page
Month of the union with Syria (1958), completion date of the Anglo-French withdrawal from Port Said (confidence 1) and the start of the Canal Zone occupation (inherited, confidence 1)
The land each member contributed and the federation's own status in 1959 are not on the page

problems: Cliopatria 'Qatar Protectorate' (both shapes, 307,788 km2) is the outline of Oman, not Qatar: reviewed 'wrong' and replaced by the State of Qatar 1973 shape; the dossier runs 1916-1971 instead of 1947-1955.

republic-of-egypt shares Wikidata Q79 with arab-republic-of-egypt: written as different states (the United Arab Republic 1958-1971 stands between them in the united-arab-republic dossier); the colour agent may still unify the colour.

Dossier spans differ from Cliopatria on purpose: kingdom-of-jordan starts 1921 (Emirate of Transjordan, renames 1946 and 1949), qatar-protectorate 1916-1971, palestinians 1948-1950 (owner row for Jordanian-occupied West Bank, extended two years), republic-of-egypt ends 1958, arab-federation ends 2 August 1958 (Cliopatria 1959 is wrong). Jordan has new 1959 keyframe; Iraq 1958-1959 must come from the iraqi-republic dossier.

state-of-israel: 10 of 13 Cliopatria shapes are 'adjust' because they draw occupied land (Sinai, Gaza, West Bank, Golan to 1981, Lebanon) as Israeli; the 1973-1975 shape wrongly omits the Sinai. Counterpart strings used for whole spans: arab-republic-of-egypt (Sinai 1967-1982), syria (Golan), palestinians (Gaza 1967-2005 and the post-1988 West Bank), as the united-arab-republic dossier already uses 'palestinians' for Gaza.

Four open events at the 2024 end (West Bank occupation, Gaza contest, Lebanon 2024, Syrian buffer zone) leave validator warnings by design; 'british-mandate-for-palestine' has no dossier yet (warning in state-of-israel and palestinians).
Sibling note: kingdom-of-egypt has vassal_start all-palestine-government (1948) with no vassal_end visible in its ledger; not edited here.
